name: Perturbed Differentiable Renderer
aliases: Approximate differentiable rendering via perturbed optimizers
definition: A differentiable rendering method that reformulates rasterization and aggregation as perturbed Linear Programming (LP) optimizers. It introduces stochastic noise to the input parameters of the argmax operation to create a smooth approximation of the non-smooth hard constraints, allowing gradients to flow to background pixels and ensuring non-null gradients everywhere.
summary: The Perturbed Differentiable Renderer makes non-smooth rasterization differentiable by applying random perturbations to optimization arguments, ensuring non-null gradients everywhere unlike methods using gradient approximations.
